storage_candidate.evidence: Lower request waiting observed during file verification at similar throughput; gameplay benefit not established.
storage_candidate.persistence: Opt-in runtime setting only. Another profile or reboot may replace it.

not_promoted.gpu_800_850_900_mhz: Lower fixed clocks did not consistently beat the retained 950 MHz configuration in controlled frame pacing and GPU job timing.
not_promoted.sched_wakeup_1ms: Small FPS increases in short samples; changing thermal ceilings and comparable tail pacing prevent a firm causal claim.
not_promoted.prefer_idle_1: No clear frame-pacing advantage in the surrounding camera trials.
not_promoted.gpu_always_on: Trial crossed scene and thermal changes; no valid improvement claim.
not_promoted.egl_multifile_32mib: Functionality verified with the old cache preserved, but a startup or gameplay speedup was not established. Original overrides restored.

limitations: The observations are device, workload, and thermal-state specific.
Presentation intervals do not measure touch-to-photon latency.
No zero-stuttering or bottleneck-free guarantee is supported by these measurements.
